## EmbeddedCommandInterpreterSpec.optionTerminatorWords property

Additional whole words that end option scanning, like zsh's `+` and `+-`<!-- -->. The terminator is not a command string; an already-selected `-c` needs a following word. `--` and a lone `-` are always terminators.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly optionTerminatorWords?: readonly string[];
```
